name: Search by GOGO GET
author: GOGO KC

sections.description:
Website Search Made Simple. Setup is Easy Without Code. Search Analytics included with AI-powered features. Try us Free for a Week!

Features:
– No Credit Card Needed for Trial, Plans starting at just $7/month.
– Customizable look and feel to match your site.
– Live search analytics to continually improve your search.
– AI-Generated Keyword Search Recommendations and Page Descriptions

Helpful Links:
* GOGO GET
* Terms & Policy
* Support

External Services

This plugin uses secure APIs to GOGO GET services to enable website search and optimization. GOGO GET also integrates with WordPress sites using additional secure APIs.
Wordpress site and page information is gathered by GOGO GET once consent is permitted.
The user is provided an API Key for their search experience created in GOGO GET.
This API Key is sent to GOGO GET to implement their search experience they created in GOGO GET in WordPress.
Search metrics are gathered real time through the search plugin. NO USER information, or location is collected through the search plugin or API.
See the GOGO GET Terms, Conditions and Privacy Policy for more details.

sections.installation:
1. Click Install Now and then Activate the plugin.
  2. Create a GOGO GET Account and pick a plan.
  3. Add your Site and Configure your Searchbar
  4. Copy your Key and paste into WordPress Admin Settings
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

This plugin installs GOGO GET onto your WordPress site via a code snippet. The snippet is loaded from an external source to bring a powerful site search to your WordPress site.

How do I configure the API key?

After activating the plugin, go to Settings > GOGO GET in your WordPress Admin dashboard. Enter your API key in the provided field and save the changes.

Is this a paid service?

Every new user is offered a 2 week trial to try out GOGO GET, and plans start at $7/month after. View plans at GOGO GET
